findings.summary: The CORS flow is written as a stack of unlabelled lines rather than an explicit diagram, so the sequence and arrows are lost.
findings.evidence:
Non-simple request
Preflight OPTIONS
Server sends ACAO
Access-Control-Allow-Origin
JS reads response
findings.fix: Render it as an arrow flow: Non-simple request -> Preflight OPTIONS -> Server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin -> JS reads response.

findings.summary: The Relaxing It section crams unrelated ideas (CORS, document.domain, wildcard with credentials) with no heading structure or example for the wildcard rule.
findings.evidence:
document.domain is deprecated: use postMessage or CORS
Wildcard * cannot be combined with credentials
findings.fix: Split into separate one-idea bullets, or add a small table of relaxation mechanisms and their status.

findings.summary: The 'Cookies' bullet is a separate idea placed under the origin definition, and the SOP table row 'Form post, img, script, link, simple GET | Sent' bundles several items in one cell.
findings.evidence: Cookies use host + path, not origin: they ignore port and scheme
findings.fix: Move the cookie note to its own labelled bullet, and keep the table rows to one request type each.

findings.summary: Code is shown before the idea behind it is stated, and the token list is an unformatted run of words.
findings.evidence:
allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals
allow-same-origin allow-top-navigation allow-downloads
Add tokens one by one, only what the widget needs
html
<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts"
findings.fix: State the one-line idea first, then show the code. Render the tokens as a table (token | enables).

findings.summary: The 'Safe vs useless' table is followed by a prose sentence repeating it, and 'Embed hygiene' bullets mix three unrelated features.
findings.evidence: On same-origin srcdoc or src, scripts plus same-origin make the sandbox useless.
findings.fix: Drop the repeated sentence or fold it into the table row, and split embed hygiene into one idea per bullet with its purpose.

findings.summary: The 'send both' note and the header snippet are placed after a table, and the sentence that CSP wins when both are present conflicts in tone with 'send both' without a clear explanation.
findings.evidence:
Both present: browsers with CSP support ignore X-Frame-Options
Send both anyway for old-browser coverage
findings.fix: Add a short rule: modern browsers use frame-ancestors, old browsers fall back to XFO, so send both.

findings.summary: The Interview Point packs three questions and answers into one run-on line.
findings.evidence: Which wins when both headers exist? frame-ancestors. Can XFO allow two origins? No. Does <meta> work? No, header only.
findings.fix: Put each question and answer on its own line or in a two-column table.

findings.summary: The receiving section lists e.origin/e.source/e.data checks as bare lines, then repeats them in a table, then in code, so the same content appears three times and the bare list is hard to follow.
findings.evidence:
e.origin
exact ===
e.source
expected window
e.data
shape and type
findings.fix: Remove the bare list and keep the table, then the code.

findings.summary: The 'e.origin' table cell holds several ideas (browser-set, unforgeable, 'null' for sandboxed/data frames), and the Mistakes section is a prose paragraph.
findings.evidence: Set by the browser, can't be forged; sandboxed or data: frames send 'null'
findings.fix: Split into separate bullets, and turn the Mistakes paragraph into bullets: origin-checked is not authenticated, still validate e.data, never trust 'null', never skip the check.

findings.summary: Policy code is shown before its idea is stated, and the rollout is a bare stack of words.
findings.evidence:
Report-Only
report-to / report-uri
Read violations
Enforce
findings.fix: Show rollout as an arrow flow: Report-Only -> collect via report-to -> read violations -> Enforce, and state the idea before the code block.

findings.summary: The directive table row lumps unrelated directives and is inconsistent about the fallback rule, which is repeated later in Mistakes.
findings.evidence:
frame-ancestors base-uri form-action | no fallback
...
default-src skips frame-ancestors, base-uri, form-action
findings.fix: State the no-fallback rule once and keep the table to one idea per row.

findings.summary: The cheat sheet's CSP starter is shown as a long single-line code block with no per-directive explanation.
findings.evidence: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-…' 'strict-dynamic'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'
findings.fix: Break the policy across lines and add a one-line purpose for each directive.
